question: According to Ayurveda, which three doshas govern the body?
explanation: Ayurveda holds that Vata, Pitta and Kapha — the three doshas — govern all physiological functions.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेद अनुसार शरीरलाई कुन तीन दोषले नियन्त्रण गर्छन्?
explanation_ne: आयुर्वेदमा वात, पित्त र कफ — तीन दोष — ले शरीरका सबै क्रियाहरू नियन्त्रण गर्छन् भन्ने मान्यता छ।

question: Vata dosha is formed by the combination of which two mahabhutas?
explanation: Vata is formed from Akasha and Vayu; Pitta from Agni and Jala; Kapha from Prithvi and Jala.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: वात दोष कुन दुई महाभूतको संयोजनबाट बन्छ?
explanation_ne: वात आकाश र वायुबाट, पित्त अग्नि र जलबाट र कफ पृथ्वी र जलबाट बन्छ।

question: How many dhatus (tissues) are described in Ayurveda?
explanation: The seven dhatus are Rasa, Rakta, Mamsa, Meda, Asthi, Majja and Shukra.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा कति धातु वर्णन गरिएका छन्?
explanation_ne: सात धातुहरू रस, रक्त, मांस, मेद, अस्थि, मज्जा र शुक्र हुन्।

question: Panchakarma consists of how many main purification procedures?
explanation: Panchakarma means five actions: Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Nasya and Raktamokshana.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पञ्चकर्ममा कति मुख्य शोधन प्रक्रिया हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: पञ्चकर्म भनेको पाँच क्रिया हुन्: वमन, विरेचन, बस्ति, नस्य र रक्तमोक्षण।

question: Vamana (therapeutic emesis) is mainly indicated for which dosha?
explanation: Vamana eliminates aggravated Kapha from the stomach and respiratory tract.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: वमन (चिकित्सकीय वान्ता) मुख्यतः कुन दोषका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: वमनले पेट र श्वासमार्गबाट बढेको कफलाई बाहिर निकाल्छ।

question: Virechana (therapeutic purgation) is mainly indicated for which dosha?
explanation: Virechana clears aggravated Pitta through the lower gut; it is the classic Pitta-shodhana.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विरेचन मुख्यतः कुन दोषका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: विरेचनले तल्लो आन्द्राबाट बढेको पित्तलाई सफा गर्छ; यो पित्त-शोधनको शास्त्रीय विधि हो।

question: Nasya therapy is administered through which route?
explanation: Nasya is the administration of medicines through the nostrils, mainly for diseases above the neck (Urdhva-jatrugata).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नस्य चिकित्सा कुन मार्गबाट दिइन्छ?
explanation_ne: नस्य नाकबाट औषधि दिने विधि हो, मुख्यतः घाँटीभन्दा माथिका रोगहरूका लागि।

question: Raktamokshana in Panchakarma means:
explanation: Raktamokshana is therapeutic bloodletting, used for blood-borne (Rakta) disorders; leech therapy (Jalaukavacharana) is one form.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पञ्चकर्ममा रक्तमोक्षण भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: रक्तमोक्षण चिकित्सकीय रूपमा रगत निकाल्ने विधि हो; जुकाले रगत निकाल्नु (जलौकावचरण) यसको एक रूप हो।

question: Which Samhita is regarded as the main text of Kayachikitsa (internal medicine)?
explanation: Charaka Samhita is the foremost authority on Kayachikitsa; Sushruta Samhita is the authority on Shalya (surgery).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कायचिकित्साको मुख्य ग्रन्थ कुन संहिता मानिन्छ?
explanation_ne: चरक संहिता कायचिकित्साको प्रमुख ग्रन्थ हो; सुश्रुत संहिता शल्य (शल्यचिकित्सा) को प्रमुख ग्रन्थ हो।

question: Sushruta, author of Sushruta Samhita, is known as the father of:
explanation: Sushruta Samhita describes surgical instruments, rhinoplasty and many operative procedures, so Sushruta is called the father of surgery.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सुश्रुत संहिताका लेखक सुश्रुतलाई कसको पिता भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: सुश्रुत संहितामा शल्य यन्त्र, नाकको शल्यक्रिया र धेरै शल्यक्रियाहरू वर्णन गरिएकाले सुश्रुतलाई शल्यचिकित्साका पिता भनिन्छ।

question: Ashtanga Hridaya was composed by:
explanation: Vagbhata authored Ashtanga Hridaya (and Ashtanga Sangraha), summarising the eight branches of Ayurveda.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अष्टाङ्ग हृदय कसले रचना गरेका हुन्?
explanation_ne: वाग्भटले अष्टाङ्ग हृदय (र अष्टाङ्ग संग्रह) लेखेका हुन्, जसमा आयुर्वेदका आठ शाखाको सार छ।

question: Triphala is a combination of which three fruits?
explanation: Triphala = Amalaki (Emblica officinalis) + Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica) + Haritaki (Terminalia chebula).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: त्रिफला कुन तीन फलको संयोजन हो?
explanation_ne: त्रिफला = अमला + बिभीतकी + हरितकी हो।

question: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) is best known in Ayurveda as a:
explanation: Ashwagandha is a Rasayana that builds strength, calms Vata and helps the body adapt to stress.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अश्वगन्धा आयुर्वेदमा मुख्यतः कुन रूपमा चिनिन्छ?
options_ne: रसायन (शक्ति बढाउने) र तनावसँग जुध्ने औषधि
explanation_ne: अश्वगन्धा एक रसायन हो जसले बल बढाउँछ, वात शान्त गर्छ र तनावसँग जुध्न मद्दत गर्छ।

question: Turmeric (Haridra, Curcuma longa) is mainly valued for its:
explanation: Haridra's active principle curcumin is anti-inflammatory and is used in wound care and skin disorders.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बेसार (हरिद्रा) मुख्यतः कुन गुणका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options_ne: सुन्निने कम गर्ने र घाउ निको पार्ने
explanation_ne: हरिद्राको सक्रिय तत्त्व कर्कुमिन सुन्निने कम गर्छ र घाउ तथा छालाका रोगमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Neem (Azadirachta indica) is classically used in Ayurveda for:
explanation: Neem is Tikta-Kashaya, Kapha-Pitta shamaka, and is used for skin diseases, wounds and blood purification.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नीम आयुर्वेदमा शास्त्रीय रूपमा कुनका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: नीम तिक्त-कषाय रसयुक्त, कफ-पित्त शामक छ र छालाका रोग, घाउ र रगत शुद्धिका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Tulsi (Ocimum sanctum) is chiefly classified as:
options: A Kapha-Vata shamaka herb useful in respiratory disorders
explanation: Tulsi is Katu-Tikta, Ushna, and pacifies Kapha-Vata; it is widely used in cough, cold and respiratory complaints.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तुलसी मुख्यतः कुन रूपमा वर्गीकृत छ?
options_ne: कफ-वात शामक, श्वास रोगमा उपयोगी जडीबुटी
explanation_ne: तुलसी कटु-तिक्त, उष्ण गुणको छ र कफ-वात शान्त गर्छ; खोकी, रुघा र श्वास रोगमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Brahmi (Bacopa monnieri) is known as a Medhya Rasayana because it:
explanation: Medhya Rasayanas nourish the mind; Brahmi is the classic herb for memory, intellect and mental clarity.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ब्राह्मीलाई मेध्य रसायन भनिन्छ किनकि यसले:
explanation_ne: मेध्य रसायनले मस्तिष्कलाई पोषण दिन्छ; ब्राह्मी स्मरणशक्ति, बुद्धि र मानसिक स्पष्टताका लागि शास्त्रीय जडीबुटी हो।

question: Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) is mainly used for:
explanation: Shatavari is the classic female Rasayana — it supports reproductive health and promotes breast milk (Stanya).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: शतावरी मुख्यतः कुनका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options_ne: महिला प्रजनन स्वास्थ्य र दूध बढाउन
explanation_ne: शतावरी महिलाका लागि शास्त्रीय रसायन हो — यसले प्रजनन स्वास्थ्य र स्तन्य (दूध) बढाउँछ।

question: Guggulu (Commiphora mukul) is classically indicated in disorders of:
explanation: Guggulu is Lekhaniya (scraping) and is used in Medoroga (obesity), arthritis and joint disorders.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गुग्गुलु शास्त्रीय रूपमा कुन रोगमा प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: गुग्गुलु लेखनीय (बोसो घटाउने) छ र मेदोरोग, गठिया र जोर्नीका रोगमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Which of the following is a Tikta (bitter) rasa dravya commonly used in fever?
explanation: Neem is Tikta-Kashaya and is used in Jwara (fever) and skin disorders; sugar is Madhura, salt is Lavana.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ज्वरोमा प्रयोग हुने तिक्त रसयुक्त द्रव्य कुन हो?
explanation_ne: नीम तिक्त-कषाय छ र ज्वर तथा छालाका रोगमा प्रयोग हुन्छ; चिनी मधुर र नुन लवण रसका हुन्।

question: Trikatu is a combination of:
explanation: Trikatu = Pippali (long pepper) + Maricha (black pepper) + Shunthi (dry ginger); it kindles Agni and clears Kapha.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: त्रिकटु कुनको संयोजन हो?
explanation_ne: त्रिकटु = पिप्पली + मरिच + सुठो हो; यसले अग्नि बढाउँछ र कफ सफा गर्छ।

question: Agni in Ayurveda refers to:
explanation: Agni governs digestion and metabolism; Jatharagni is the central digestive fire, with 5 Bhutagni and 7 Dhatvagni — 13 in total.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा अग्नि भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: अग्निले पाचन र चयापचय नियन्त्रण गर्छ; जठराग्नि मुख्य पाचक अग्नि हो, ५ भूताग्नि र ७ धात्वाग्नि गरी जम्मा १३ हुन्छन्।

question: Ojas is described as the essence of:
options: All seven dhatus, responsible for immunity and vitality
explanation: Ojas is the finest essence of all dhatus; it sustains immunity, strength and life itself.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ओजसलाई के को सार भनिन्छ?
options_ne: सबै सात धातुको सार, रोग प्रतिरोध र जीवनशक्तिको स्रोत
explanation_ne: ओजस सबै धातुको उत्कृष्ट सार हो; यसले रोग प्रतिरोध क्षमता, बल र जीवनलाई धान्छ।

question: Dinacharya in Ayurveda means:
explanation: Dinacharya is the daily routine (waking, cleansing, exercise, diet) for health; Ritucharya is the seasonal regimen.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा दिनचर्या भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: दिनचर्या स्वास्थ्यका लागि दैनिक नियम (उठ्ने, शुद्धि, व्यायाम, आहार) हो; ऋतुचर्या मौसमी नियम हो।

question: How many Ritus (seasons) are described in Ayurveda?
explanation: The six Ritus are Hemanta, Shishira, Vasanta, Grishma, Varsha and Sharad.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा कति ऋतु वर्णन गरिएका छन्?
explanation_ne: छ ऋतुहरू हेमन्त, शिशिर, वसन्त, ग्रीष्म, वर्षा र शरद् हुन्।

question: Swasthavritta is the Ayurvedic branch dealing with:
explanation: Swasthavritta covers Dinacharya, Ritucharya, Sadvritta and personal/public hygiene for disease prevention.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: स्वस्थवृत्त आयुर्वेदको कुन शाखा हो?
explanation_ne: स्वस्थवृत्तमा दिनचर्या, ऋतुचर्या, सद्वृत्त र व्यक्तिगत/सार्वजनिक स्वच्छता पर्छन्।

question: Rasashastra deals with the use of:
options: Metals, minerals and mercury in medicine
explanation: Rasashastra is the science of herbo-mineral preparations, including purified mercury (Parada) and metals.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रसशास्त्र कुनसँग सम्बन्धित छ?
options_ne: औषधिमा धातु, खनिज र पारदको प्रयोग
explanation_ne: रसशास्त्र जडीबुटी-खनिज औषधिको विज्ञान हो, जसमा शुद्ध पारद (पारो) र धातुहरू पर्छन्।

question: Dravyaguna is the Ayurvedic science of:
options: Pharmacology — properties and actions of drugs
explanation: Dravyaguna studies Rasa, Guna, Virya, Vipaka and Prabhava of medicinal substances.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: द्रव्यगुण आयुर्वेदको कुन विज्ञान हो?
explanation_ne: द्रव्यगुणले औषधिका रस, गुण, वीर्य, विपाक र प्रभाव अध्ययन गर्छ।

question: Kaumarbhritya is the Ayurvedic branch of:
explanation: Kaumarbhritya (Bala Roga) deals with child health; Kashyapa Samhita is its main text.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कौमारभृत्य आयुर्वेदको कुन शाखा हो?
explanation_ne: कौमारभृत्य (बाल रोग) बाल स्वास्थ्यसँग सम्बन्धित छ; काश्यप संहिता यसको मुख्य ग्रन्थ हो।

question: Shalakya Tantra deals mainly with diseases of:
options: Eye, ear, nose, throat and head
explanation: Shalakya covers Urdhva-jatrugata (above the clavicle) diseases — eye, ENT, mouth and head.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: शलाक्य तन्त्र मुख्यतः कुनका रोगसँग सम्बन्धित छ?
options_ne: आँखा, कान, नाक, घाँटी र टाउको
explanation_ne: शलाक्यले उर्ध्व-जत्रुगत (घाँटीभन्दा माथिका) — आँखा, कान-नाक-घाँटी, मुख र टाउकोका रोगहरू समेट्छ।

question: Agada Tantra is the Ayurvedic branch of:
explanation: Agada Tantra deals with poisons, venoms, bites and their antidotes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अगद तन्त्र आयुर्वेदको कुन शाखा हो?
explanation_ne: अगद तन्त्रले विष, विषालु जीवका टोकाइ र तिनका प्रतिविषबारे अध्ययन गर्छ।

question: Prasuti Tantra and Stri Roga deal with:
explanation: Prasuti Tantra covers pregnancy, labour and postnatal care; Stri Roga covers women's diseases.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रसूति तन्त्र र स्त्री रोग के सँग सम्बन्धित छन्?
explanation_ne: प्रसूति तन्त्रले गर्भावस्था, प्रसव र सुत्केरी हेरचाह समेट्छ; स्त्री रोगले महिलाका रोगहरू समेट्छ।

question: Nadi Pariksha in Ayurveda is examination of the:
explanation: Nadi Pariksha (pulse diagnosis) is one of the Ashtavidha Pariksha (eight examinations) for assessing dosha status.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा नाडी परीक्षा भनेको के को जाँच हो?
explanation_ne: नाडी परीक्षा दोषको अवस्था थाहा पाउन गरिने अष्टविध परीक्षामध्ये एक हो।

question: Ashtavidha Pariksha consists of how many examinations?
explanation: Ashtavidha Pariksha = Nadi, Mutra, Mala, Jihva, Shabda, Sparsha, Drika and Akriti.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अष्टविध परीक्षामा कति जाँच हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: अष्टविध परीक्षा = नाडी, मूत्र, मल, जिह्वा, शब्द, स्पर्श, दृक् र आकृति हुन्।

question: Madhava Nidana is a classical text on:
explanation: Madhava Nidana (Roga Vinishchaya) is the foremost Ayurvedic text on disease diagnosis.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: माधव निदान कुन विषयको शास्त्रीय ग्रन्थ हो?
explanation_ne: माधव निदान (रोग विनिश्चय) रोग निदानको प्रमुख आयुर्वेदिक ग्रन्थ हो।

question: Which of the following is the correct sequence of the seven dhatus?
options: Shukra → Majja → Asthi → Meda → Mamsa → Rakta → Rasa
Rasa → Rakta → Mamsa → Meda → Asthi → Majja → Shukra
Rakta → Rasa → Meda → Mamsa → Majja → Asthi → Shukra
Mamsa → Rasa → Rakta → Asthi → Meda → Shukra → Majja
explanation: Dhatus are nourished in sequence: each dhatu is formed from the previous one, ending in Shukra.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सात धातुहरूको सही क्रम कुन हो?
options_ne: शुक्र → मज्जा → अस्थि → मेद → मांस → रक्त → रस
रस → रक्त → मांस → मेद → अस्थि → मज्जा → शुक्र
रक्त → रस → मेद → मांस → मज्जा → अस्थि → शुक्र
मांस → रस → रक्त → अस्थि → मेद → शुक्र → मज्जा
explanation_ne: धातुहरू क्रमशः पोषित हुन्छन्: प्रत्येक धातु अघिल्लोबाट बन्छ र अन्तमा शुक्र बन्छ।

question: Snehana in Panchakarma means:
options: Oleation (internal/external use of oil or ghee)
explanation: Snehana (oleation) is the preparatory (Purvakarma) step before the main Panchakarma procedures.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पञ्चकर्ममा स्नेहन भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: स्नेहन मुख्य पञ्चकर्म प्रक्रियाअघिको तयारी (पूर्वकर्म) चरण हो।

question: Swedana in Panchakarma means:
explanation: Swedana induces sweating to liquefy doshas after Snehana, as part of Purvakarma.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पञ्चकर्ममा स्वेदन भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: स्वेदनले स्नेहनपछि दोषलाई पगाल्न पसिना निकाल्छ; यो पूर्वकर्मको भाग हो।

question: Abhyanga is:
options: Ayurvedic oil massage of the whole body
explanation: Abhyanga is full-body oil massage, used daily in Dinacharya and as Purvakarma.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अभ्यंग भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: अभ्यंग सम्पूर्ण शरीरको तेल मालिस हो, दिनचर्यामा दैनिक र पूर्वकर्मका रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Shirodhara is a therapy in which:
options: Warm oil is poured in a continuous stream over the forehead
Oil is put in the ears
explanation: Shirodhara calms Vata and the mind; it is used for insomnia, anxiety and stress.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: शिरोधारा कस्तो चिकित्सा हो?
explanation_ne: शिरोधारा वात र मन शान्त गर्छ; अनिद्रा, चिन्ता र तनावमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Kshara Sutra, described by Sushruta, is mainly used for:
explanation: Kshara Sutra (medicated alkaline thread) is the classical Ayurvedic treatment for Bhagandara (fistula-in-ano).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सुश्रुतले वर्णन गरेको क्षारसूत्र मुख्यतः कुनका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: क्षारसूत्र (औषधीय क्षारीय धागो) भगन्दरको शास्त्रीय आयुर्वेदिक उपचार हो।

question: Jalaukavacharana (leech therapy) is a type of:
explanation: Leech application is a non-surgical form of bloodletting used in skin and blood disorders.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: जलौकावचरण (जुका चिकित्सा) कुनको एक प्रकार हो?
explanation_ne: जुकाको प्रयोग छाला र रक्त रोगमा गरिने शल्यक्रियाबिनाको रक्तमोक्षण विधि हो।

question: According to Ayurveda, heated honey is considered:
explanation: Classical texts warn that honey should never be heated, as it becomes toxic (Ama-forming) when heated.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेद अनुसार तातो महलाई के मानिन्छ?
explanation_ne: शास्त्रीय ग्रन्थहरूले मह कहिल्यै तताउनु हुँदैन भन्छन्, किनकि तात्दा यो विषाक्त (आम बनाउने) हुन्छ।

question: Chyawanprash is mainly based on which fruit?
explanation: Chyawanprash is an Amalaki-based Rasayana for immunity, strength and general health.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: च्यवनप्राश मुख्यतः कुन फलबाट बनेको हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: च्यवनप्राश अमलामा आधारित रसायन हो, रोग प्रतिरोध, बल र सामान्य स्वास्थ्यका लागि।

question: Dashamula is a combination of how many roots?
explanation: Dashamula = five Brihat Panchamula roots + five Laghu Panchamula roots; it is used in Vata disorders and fever.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दशमूल कति जराको संयोजन हो?
explanation_ne: दशमूल = पाँच बृहत् पञ्चमूल + पाँच लघु पञ्चमूल; वात रोग र ज्वरोमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Rasayana therapy in Ayurveda aims at:
explanation: Rasayana rebuilds dhatus, delays ageing and strengthens Ojas and immunity.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा रसायन चिकित्साको उद्देश्य के हो?
explanation_ne: रसायनले धातु पुनर्निर्माण गर्छ, बुढ्यौली ढिलो गर्छ र ओजस् तथा प्रतिरोध क्षमता बढाउँछ।

question: Vajikarana is the Ayurvedic branch dealing with:
explanation: Vajikarana is one of the eight branches (Ashtanga), concerned with virility and reproductive health.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: वाजीकरण आयुर्वेदको कुन शाखा हो?
explanation_ne: वाजीकरण अष्टाङ्गमध्ये एक शाखा हो, जुन पुरुषत्व र प्रजनन स्वास्थ्यसँग सम्बन्धित छ।

question: Dhanvantari is regarded in Ayurveda as:
options: The god of Ayurveda and medicine
explanation: Dhanvantari, who emerged during Samudra Manthan, is worshipped as the divine source of Ayurveda.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: धन्वन्तरिलाई आयुर्वेदमा के मानिन्छ?
explanation_ne: समुद्र मन्थनबाट प्रकट भएका धन्वन्तरिलाई आयुर्वेदका दिव्य स्रोतका रूपमा पूजा गरिन्छ।

question: Which season is best for Vamana according to Ritucharya?
explanation: Kapha accumulates in Hemanta-Shishira and aggravates in Vasanta, so Vamana is done in spring.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ऋतुचर्याअनुसार वमनका लागि उत्तम ऋतु कुन हो?
explanation_ne: कफ हेमन्त-शिशिरमा जम्मा हुन्छ र वसन्तमा बढ्छ, त्यसैले वमन वसन्तमा गरिन्छ।

question: Anupana in Ayurveda means:
options: The vehicle (e.g. honey, warm water, ghee) taken with medicine
explanation: Anupana is the adjuvant/vehicle that helps carry the drug to its target and enhances its action.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा अनुपान भनेको के हो?
options_ne: औषधिसँग लिइने सहायक पदार्थ (मह, तातो पानी, घिउ)
explanation_ne: अनुपान औषधिलाई लक्ष्यसम्म पुर्‍याउने र त्यसको क्रिया बढाउने सहायक पदार्थ हो।

question: Sadvritta in Ayurveda refers to:
options: A code of good conduct for physical, mental and social health
explanation: Sadvritta is the ethical and behavioural code — truthfulness, cleanliness, respect — for a healthy life.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा सद्वृत्त भनेको के हो?
options_ne: शारीरिक, मानसिक र सामाजिक स्वास्थ्यका लागि आचारसंहिता
explanation_ne: सद्वृत्त सत्यता, स्वच्छता, सम्मान जस्ता नैतिक र व्यवहारिक नियमहरूको संहिता हो।

question: Which of the following is a Shodhana (purification) therapy?
explanation: Shodhana eliminates doshas from the body (Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Nasya, Raktamokshana); Shamana only pacifies them.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन शोधन (शुद्धि) चिकित्सा हो?
explanation_ne: शोधनले दोषलाई शरीरबाट बाहिर निकाल्छ (वमन, विरेचन, बस्ति, नस्य, रक्तमोक्षण); शमनले मात्र शान्त गर्छ।

question: Ghee (Ghrita) is considered best for pacifying which dosha?
explanation: Ghrita is Madhura, Sheeta and pacifies Pitta and Vata; it is the classic Sneha dravya.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: घिउ कुन दोष शान्त गर्न उत्तम मानिन्छ?
explanation_ne: घिउ मधुर, शीतल छ र पित्त तथा वात शान्त गर्छ; यो शास्त्रीय स्नेह द्रव्य हो।

question: Which herb is known as the 'queen of herbs' and is used for female health in Ayurveda?
explanation: Shatavari is called the queen of herbs for its Rasayana action on the female reproductive system.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा 'जडीबुटीकी रानी' भनेर चिनिने र महिला स्वास्थ्यमा प्रयोग हुने जडीबुटी कुन हो?
explanation_ne: शतावरी महिला प्रजनन प्रणालीमा रसायन क्रियाका कारण 'जडीबुटीकी रानी' कहलिन्छ।

question: Kati Basti is a Panchakarma-related therapy applied to the:
explanation: Kati Basti pools warm medicated oil over the lumbosacral area for low back pain and disc disorders.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कटि बस्ति शरीरको कुन भागमा गरिने चिकित्सा हो?
explanation_ne: कटि बस्तिमा कम्मर क्षेत्रमा तातो औषधीय तेल राखिन्छ; ढाड दुखाइ र डिस्क रोगमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Netra Tarpana is an Ayurvedic therapy for the:
explanation: Netra Tarpana pools medicated ghee over the eyes to nourish them; it is used in eye strain and dryness.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: नेत्र तर्पण कुनका लागि गरिने आयुर्वेदिक चिकित्सा हो?
explanation_ne: नेत्र तर्पणमा आँखामा औषधीय घिउ राखिन्छ; आँखा थकाइ र सुख्खापनमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Karnapoorana means filling the ear with:
explanation: Karnapoorana is instilling warm oil in the ears for ear disorders and Vata in the head region.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कर्णपूरण भनेको कानमा के हाल्नु हो?
explanation_ne: कर्णपूरण कानका रोग र टाउको क्षेत्रको वातका लागि कानमा तातो तेल हाल्ने विधि हो।

question: Agnikarma is a para-surgical procedure that uses:
options: Heat (cauterisation) to treat pain and chronic lesions
explanation: Agnikarma uses heated metal instruments (Shalaka) for cauterisation in joint pain, warts and chronic wounds.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अग्निकर्म कस्तो शल्य-क्रिया हो?
options_ne: तातोले दाग्ने (दहन) — दुखाइ र पुराना घाउमा
explanation_ne: अग्निकर्ममा तातो धातुको यन्त्रले दागिन्छ; जोर्नी दुखाइ, मुसा र पुराना घाउमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Udvartana is a massage done with:
explanation: Udvartana uses dry herbal powders massaged upward; it reduces Kapha and Meda and is used in obesity.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: उद्वर्तन कस्तो मालिस हो?
explanation_ne: उद्वर्तनमा सुख्खा जडीबुटीका धुलोले माथितिर मालिस गरिन्छ; यसले कफ र मेद घटाउँछ र मोटोपनमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Which of the following is a Medhya (brain tonic) herb pair?
explanation: Brahmi and Shankhapushpi are the two classic Medhya Rasayanas for memory and intellect.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन मेध्य (मस्तिष्क बलियो बनाउने) जडीबुटी जोडी हो?
explanation_ne: ब्राह्मी र शंखपुष्पी स्मरणशक्ति र बुद्धिका लागि दुई शास्त्रीय मेध्य रसायन हुन्।

question: Shilajit is mainly used in Ayurveda as a:
options: Rasayana and rejuvenative for strength and vitality
explanation: Shilajit is a mineral pitch Rasayana used for strength, stamina, diabetes and general debility.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: शिलाजीत आयुर्वेदमा मुख्यतः कुन रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: शिलाजीत खनिज रसायन हो, बल, सहनशीलता, मधुमेह र सामान्य कमजोरीमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Yashtimadhu (liquorice, Glycyrrhiza glabra) is mainly used for:
options: Cough, sore throat and gastric ulcers
explanation: Yashtimadhu is Madhura, demulcent and expectorant — used in cough, throat irritation and acidity/ulcers.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: यष्टीमधु (मुलेठी) मुख्यतः कुनका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ?
options_ne: खोकी, घाँटी दुखाइ र पेटको अल्सर
explanation_ne: यष्टीमधु मधुर, शामक र कफ निस्कासन गर्ने छ — खोकी, घाँटी दुखाइ र अम्लता/अल्सरमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Giloy (Guduchi, Tinospora cordifolia) is best known as:
explanation: Guduchi is a Rasayana and Jwaraghna — it boosts immunity and is widely used in fever, including chronic and viral fevers.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गिलोय (गुडुची) मुख्यतः कुन रूपमा चिनिन्छ?
options_ne: रोग प्रतिरोध बढाउने र ज्वरो घटाउने
explanation_ne: गुडुची रसायन र ज्वरघ्न हो — यसले प्रतिरोध क्षमता बढाउँछ र ज्वरोमा व्यापक रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Which dosha is dominant in childhood (Balya avastha) according to Ayurveda?
explanation: Kapha dominates childhood (growth phase), Pitta dominates youth/middle age, and Vata dominates old age.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदअनुसार बाल्यावस्थामा कुन दोष प्रधान हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बाल्यावस्थामा कफ, युवावस्थामा पित्त र वृद्धावस्थामा वात प्रधान हुन्छ।

question: Which dosha predominates in old age (Vriddha avastha)?
explanation: Vata increases with age, causing dryness, joint pain and degeneration in the elderly.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: वृद्धावस्थामा कुन दोष प्रधान हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: उमेरसँगै वात बढ्छ, जसले वृद्धहरूमा सुख्खापन, जोर्नी दुखाइ र क्षय ल्याउँछ।

question: In Ayurveda, the midday period (10 am – 2 pm) is dominated by which dosha?
explanation: Kapha dominates 6–10 am, Pitta 10 am–2 pm, and Vata 2–6 pm; the same cycle repeats at night.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदअनुसार मध्यान्ह (बिहान १० – दिउँसो २) मा कुन दोष प्रधान हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बिहान ६–१० कफ, १०–२ पित्त र २–६ वात प्रधान हुन्छन्; राति पनि यही चक्र दोहोरिन्छ।

question: Which of the following is a Kapha-aggravating factor?
options: Cold, heavy and oily food with daytime sleep
explanation: Kapha increases with cold, heavy, oily food, daytime sleep (Divaswapna) and lack of exercise.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुनले कफ बढाउँछ?
options_ne: चिसो, भारी र चिल्लो खाना तथा दिउँसो सुत्नु
explanation_ne: कफ चिसो, भारी, चिल्लो खाना, दिउँसो सुत्नु र व्यायाम नगर्दा बढ्छ।

question: Langhana therapy means:
options: Lightening therapy — fasting, light diet and exercise to reduce doshas
explanation: Langhana reduces aggravated doshas (opposite of Brihana, nourishing therapy).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: लंघन चिकित्सा भनेको के हो?
options_ne: हल्का बनाउने चिकित्सा — उपवास, हल्का आहार र व्यायाम
explanation_ne: लंघनले बढेका दोष घटाउँछ (यसको विपरीत बृंहण — पोषण चिकित्सा हो)।

question: Brihana therapy means:
options: Nourishing therapy to build dhatus and strength
explanation: Brihana (Santarpana) nourishes emaciated patients and builds tissues; Langhana is its opposite.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बृंहण चिकित्सा भनेको के हो?
options_ne: धातु र बल बढाउने पोषण चिकित्सा
explanation_ne: बृंहण (संतर्पण) ले दुब्ला बिरामीलाई पोषण दिन्छ र धातु बनाउँछ; लंघन यसको विपरीत हो।

question: Which classical text is known as the 'Laghutrayi' member focused on paediatrics?
explanation: Kashyapa Samhita (Vriddha Jivaka Tantra) is the main text of Kaumarbhritya (paediatrics).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बालरोगमा केन्द्रित शास्त्रीय ग्रन्थ कुन हो?
explanation_ne: काश्यप संहिता (वृद्ध जीवक तन्त्र) कौमारभृत्य (बालरोग) को मुख्य ग्रन्थ हो।

question: The three pillars (Trayopastambha) of health in Ayurveda are:
explanation: Ahara (diet), Nidra (sleep) and Brahmacharya (regulated conduct) are the three supports of life.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा स्वास्थ्यका तीन स्तम्भ (त्रयोपस्तम्भ) के हुन्?
explanation_ne: आहार, निद्रा र ब्रह्मचर्य जीवनका तीन आधार हुन्।

question: Marma points in Ayurveda number:
explanation: There are 107 Marma (vital) points described by Sushruta, where Prana resides.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा मर्म बिन्दु कति छन्?
explanation_ne: सुश्रुतले वर्णन गरेका १०७ मर्म (प्राण) बिन्दु छन्।

question: Which of the following is NOT one of the five Karmas of Panchakarma?
explanation: The five Karmas are Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Nasya and Raktamokshana; Abhyanga is a Purvakarma (preparatory) procedure.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन पञ्चकर्मका पाँच कर्ममध्ये पर्दैन?
explanation_ne: पाँच कर्म वमन, विरेचन, बस्ति, नस्य र रक्तमोक्षण हुन्; अभ्यंग पूर्वकर्म (तयारी) प्रक्रिया हो।

question: The main seat (Sthana) of Pitta dosha is:
explanation: Pitta's main seat is Nabhi/Grahani (small intestine); Kapha sits in Amashaya and Vata in Pakwashaya.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पित्त दोषको मुख्य स्थान कुन हो?
explanation_ne: पित्तको मुख्य स्थान नाभि/ग्रहणी (सानो आन्द्रा) हो; कफ आमाशयमा र वात पक्वाशयमा बस्छ।

question: The main seat of Kapha dosha is:
explanation: Kapha's main seat is the stomach and chest; Vata sits in the colon and Pitta in the navel region.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कफ दोषको मुख्य स्थान कुन हो?
explanation_ne: कफको मुख्य स्थान पेट र छाती हो; वात ठूलो आन्द्रामा र पित्त नाभि क्षेत्रमा बस्छ।

question: Which type of Basti uses only oil (Sneha) without decoction?
explanation: Anuvasana Basti is oil-only enema; Niruha Basti is decoction-based (Kashaya) and is the main cleansing enema.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कुन बस्तिमा काढाबिना तेल मात्र प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: अनुवासन बस्ति तेल मात्रको एनिमा हो; निरुह बस्ति काढामा आधारित र मुख्य सफा गर्ने बस्ति हो।

question: Niruha Basti is also known as:
explanation: Niruha (decoction) Basti is called Asthapana because it 'establishes' strength and removes doshas.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: निरुह बस्तिलाई अर्को के भनिन्छ?
explanation_ne: निरुह (काढा) बस्तिलाई आस्थापन भनिन्छ किनकि यसले बल स्थापित गर्छ र दोष निकाल्छ।

question: Which herb is the main ingredient of the classical formulation 'Dashamula Kwatha'?
explanation: Dashamula Kwatha is a decoction of ten roots — five Brihat and five Laghu Panchamula.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दशमूल क्वाथको मुख्य सामग्री के हो?
explanation_ne: दशमूल क्वाथ दश जराको काढा हो — पाँच बृहत् र पाँच लघु पञ्चमूल।

question: The first permanent tooth to erupt is usually the:
explanation: The first permanent molar erupts around age 6, behind the deciduous molars; it is often called the '6-year molar'.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सामान्यतया सबैभन्दा पहिले निस्कने स्थायी दाँत कुन हो?
explanation_ne: पहिलो स्थायी मोलर लगभग ६ वर्षमा निस्कन्छ; यसलाई '६ वर्षे दाँत' भनिन्छ।

question: The first deciduous tooth usually erupts at about:
explanation: The lower central incisors are usually the first to erupt, at around 6 months of age.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पहिलो दूधे दाँत सामान्यतया कति उमेरमा निस्कन्छ?
explanation_ne: तल्लो बीचका दाँत सामान्यतया सबैभन्दा पहिले, लगभग ६ महिनामा निस्कन्छन्।

question: Dental plaque is best described as:
options: A soft, sticky bacterial biofilm on teeth
explanation: Plaque is a soft biofilm of bacteria and food debris; if not removed it mineralises into calculus (tartar).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दन्त प्लाक भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: प्लाक जीवाणु र खानाका अवशेषको नरम तह हो; नहटाएमा यो क्यालकुलस (टार्टर) मा परिणत हुन्छ।

question: Calculus (tartar) differs from plaque because it is:
options: Mineralised and cannot be removed by brushing
explanation: Calculus is hardened, mineralised plaque that can only be removed by professional scaling.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्यालकुलस (टार्टर) प्लाकभन्दा फरक छ किनकि यो:
explanation_ne: क्यालकुलस कडा भएको खनिजयुक्त प्लाक हो जुन पेशागत स्केलिङबाट मात्र हटाउन सकिन्छ।

question: The main bacterium associated with dental caries is:
explanation: Streptococcus mutans ferments sugars to acid, demineralising enamel and starting caries.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दाँत किराले खाने (क्यारिज) सँग मुख्यतः सम्बन्धित जीवाणु कुन हो?
explanation_ne: स्ट्रेप्टोकोकस म्युटन्सले चिनीबाट अम्ल बनाउँछ, जसले इनामेल खियाएर क्यारिज सुरु गर्छ।

question: Fluoride prevents caries mainly by:
options: Forming fluorapatite, which resists acid attack
explanation: Fluoride replaces hydroxyl ions in enamel to form fluorapatite, which is more acid-resistant, and it promotes remineralisation.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फ्लोराइडले मुख्यतः कसरी क्यारिज रोक्छ?
options_ne: फ्लोरएपेटाइट बनाएर, जसले अम्लको आक्रमण सहन्छ
explanation_ne: फ्लोराइडले इनामेलमा हाइड्रोक्सिल आयन प्रतिस्थापन गरी फ्लोरएपेटाइट बनाउँछ, जुन अम्लप्रति बढी प्रतिरोधी हुन्छ र पुनः खनिजीकरण बढाउँछ।

question: The recommended fluoride concentration in toothpaste for adults is about:
explanation: Standard adult toothpaste contains 1000–1500 ppm fluoride; higher-strength pastes are prescription-only.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: वयस्कका लागि टुथपेस्टमा सिफारिस गरिएको फ्लोराइड मात्रा लगभग कति हो?
explanation_ne: सामान्य वयस्क टुथपेस्टमा १०००–१५०० पिपिएम फ्लोराइड हुन्छ; बढी मात्राका पेस्ट चिकित्सकको सिफारिसमा मात्र पाइन्छ।

question: The Bass technique of toothbrushing is characterised by:
options: Short vibratory strokes at 45° to the gumline
Circular strokes on the tongue only
explanation: The Bass method places bristles at 45° into the gingival sulcus with gentle short vibrations — ideal for plaque removal at the gumline.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बास प्रविधिको दाँत माझ्ने तरिका कस्तो हुन्छ?
options_ne: गिजाको रेखामा ४५° कोणमा छोटा कम्पनयुक्त चलाइ
explanation_ne: बास विधिमा ब्रिसललाई गिजाको खाडलमा ४५° कोणमा राखेर हल्का छोटा कम्पन गरिन्छ — गिजाको रेखाको प्लाक हटाउन उत्तम।

question: How long should effective toothbrushing last?
explanation: Brushing for about 2 minutes, twice daily, is the standard recommendation for plaque removal.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रभावकारी दाँत माझ्न कति समय लाग्नुपर्छ?
explanation_ne: दिनमा दुई पटक लगभग २ मिनेट माझ्नु प्लाक हटाउन मानक सिफारिस हो।

question: Gingivitis is inflammation limited to the:
explanation: Gingivitis affects only the gums and is reversible; periodontitis involves bone and attachment loss and is largely irreversible.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: जिन्जिभाइटिस भनेको कुनको सुन्निने हो?
explanation_ne: जिन्जिभाइटिसले गिजा मात्र असर गर्छ र फिर्ता हुन सक्छ; पिरियोडोन्टाइटिसमा हड्डी र आसक्ति नोक्सान हुन्छ।

question: A periodontal pocket is measured with a:
explanation: A calibrated periodontal probe measures pocket depth in millimetres from the gingival margin to the base of the pocket.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: पिरियोडोन्टल पकेट के ले नापिन्छ?
explanation_ne: क्यालिब्रेटेड पिरियोडोन्टल प्रोबले गिजाको किनारादेखि खाडलको आधारसम्म गहिराइ मिलिमिटरमा नाप्छ।

question: Scaling in dentistry means:
options: Removal of calculus from tooth surfaces
explanation: Scaling removes supra- and sub-gingival calculus; root planing smooths the root surface afterwards.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दन्तचिकित्सामा स्केलिङ भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: स्केलिङले गिजामाथि र गिजामुनिको क्यालकुलस हटाउँछ; रुट प्लानिङले जराको सतह चिल्लो बनाउँछ।

question: Which radiograph is best for detecting interproximal caries?
explanation: Bitewing radiographs show the crowns of upper and lower teeth together and are best for interproximal caries and bone levels.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दाँतबीचको क्यारिज पत्ता लगाउन उत्तम एक्स-रे कुन हो?
explanation_ne: बाइटविङले माथिल्लो र तल्लो दाँतका मुकुट एकैसाथ देखाउँछ र दाँतबीचको क्यारिज तथा हड्डीको स्तरका लागि उत्तम छ।

question: OPG in dentistry stands for:
explanation: An OPG is a panoramic X-ray showing all teeth, jaws and surrounding structures in one image.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दन्तचिकित्सामा ओपिजी भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: ओपिजी एक पानोरामिक एक्स-रे हो जसले सबै दाँत, बंगारा र वरपरका संरचना एकै तस्बिरमा देखाउँछ।

question: Dental sealants are applied to:
options: Pits and fissures of molars to prevent caries
explanation: Sealants are flowable resin coatings placed in deep pits and fissures of molars, where caries most often starts in children.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दन्त सिलेन्ट कुनमा लगाइन्छ?
options_ne: मोलरका खाडल र चिरामा क्यारिज रोक्न
explanation_ne: सिलेन्ट मोलरका गहिरा खाडल र चिरामा लगाइने रेजिन हो, जहाँ बच्चामा क्यारिज प्रायः सुरु हुन्छ।

question: Leukoplakia in the mouth is best described as:
options: A red ulcer that heals in days
A fungal infection that wipes away
A white patch that cannot be scraped off
explanation: Leukoplakia is a white plaque that cannot be scraped off; it is a potentially malignant lesion, often linked to tobacco and betel nut.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मुखमा ल्युकोप्लाकिया भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: ल्युकोप्लाकिया नखुर्किने सेतो दाग हो; यो सम्भावित क्यान्सरपूर्व घाउ हो, प्रायः सुर्ती र सुपारीसँग सम्बन्धित।

question: Oral candidiasis (thrush) is caused by:
explanation: Candida albicans is a fungus causing white, scrapable patches, common in infants, diabetics and immunocompromised patients.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मुखको क्यान्डिडियासिस (थ्रस) कुनले हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: क्यान्डिडा अल्बिकान्स ढुसी हो जसले सेतो, खुर्किने दाग बनाउँछ; शिशु, मधुमेह र प्रतिरोध कम भएकामा बढी हुन्छ।

question: Angle's Class I malocclusion means:
options: Normal molar relationship with malaligned teeth
explanation: In Class I the first molars are in normal relation but teeth are crowded or misaligned; Class II = lower molar behind, Class III = lower molar forward.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एंगलको क्लास I म्यालोक्लुजन भनेको के हो?
options_ne: मोलर सम्बन्ध सामान्य तर दाँत बाङ्गा
explanation_ne: क्लास I मा पहिलो मोलर सामान्य सम्बन्धमा हुन्छन् तर दाँत बाङ्गा हुन्छन्; क्लास II मा तल्लो मोलर पछाडि र क्लास III मा अगाडि हुन्छ।

question: Angle's Class III malocclusion is characterised by:
options: Lower first molar positioned forward (mesial) to normal
explanation: Class III (mesial occlusion) shows a forward lower jaw/molar — often an underbite appearance.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एंगलको क्लास III म्यालोक्लुजनको विशेषता के हो?
explanation_ne: क्लास III (मेसियल ओक्लुजन) मा तल्लो बंगारा/मोलर अगाडि हुन्छ — प्रायः अन्डरबाइट देखिन्छ।

question: Dental amalgam is an alloy mainly of:
explanation: Amalgam is made by mixing alloy powder (silver, tin, copper) with liquid mercury.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दन्त अमाल्गम मुख्यतः कुनको मिश्रधातु हो?
explanation_ne: अमाल्गम मिश्रधातुको धुलो (चाँदी, टिन, तामा) लाई तरल पारोसँग मिसाएर बनाइन्छ।

question: Glass ionomer cement (GIC) is valued in dentistry because it:
options: Releases fluoride and bonds chemically to tooth
explanation: GIC bonds chemically to enamel/dentine and releases fluoride, so it is used in children's and cervical fillings.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ग्लास आयोनोमर सिमेन्ट (जिआइसी) किन मूल्यवान छ?
options_ne: यसले फ्लोराइड छोड्छ र दाँतसँग रासायनिक रूपमा टाँसिन्छ
explanation_ne: जिआइसी इनामेल/डेन्टिनसँग रासायनिक रूपमा टाँसिन्छ र फ्लोराइड छोड्छ, त्यसैले बच्चा र गिजा नजिकका भर्नामा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Alginate is used in dentistry mainly for:
options: Taking impressions of teeth and arches
explanation: Alginate is an elastic impression material mixed with water, used for study models and denture impressions.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एल्जिनेट दन्तचिकित्सामा मुख्यतः कुनका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: एल्जिनेट पानीसँग मिसाएर बनाइने लचिलो छाप सामग्री हो, अध्ययन मोडेल र डेन्चर छापका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: The most reliable method of sterilising dental instruments is:
explanation: An autoclave uses steam at 121°C for 15–20 minutes (or 134°C for 3–5 minutes) and kills all microbes including spores.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दन्त यन्त्रहरू निर्जलीकरण गर्ने सबैभन्दा भरपर्दो विधि कुन हो?
explanation_ne: अटोक्लेभले १२१°से मा १५–२० मिनेट (वा १३४°से मा ३–५ मिनेट) बाफ प्रयोग गर्छ र बीजाणुसहित सबै जीवाणु मार्छ।

question: What temperature and time are standard for autoclave sterilisation?
explanation: Standard gravity autoclave: 121°C at 15 psi for 15–20 minutes; the faster cycle is 134°C for 3–5 minutes.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अटोक्लेभ निर्जलीकरणको मानक तापक्रम र समय के हो?
explanation_ne: मानक अटोक्लेभ: १२१°से, १५ पिएसआईमा १५–२० मिनेट; छिटो चक्र १३४°से मा ३–५ मिनेट हो।

question: DMFT index in community dentistry measures:
explanation: DMFT counts decayed, missing (due to caries) and filled permanent teeth — the WHO standard caries index.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सामुदायिक दन्तचिकित्सामा डिएमएफटी सूचकले के नाप्छ?
options_ne: किरा लागेका, झरेका र भरिएका दाँत
explanation_ne: डिएमएफटीले किरा लागेका, (किराका कारण) झरेका र भरिएका स्थायी दाँत गन्छ — यो डब्लुएचओको मानक सूचक हो।

question: The most common medical emergency in a dental clinic is:
explanation: Vasovagal syncope (fainting from anxiety/pain) is the commonest dental emergency; it is managed by supine position and oxygen.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दन्त क्लिनिकमा सबैभन्दा सामान्य चिकित्सकीय आकस्मिक अवस्था कुन हो?
explanation_ne: भासोभेगल मूर्छा (चिन्ता/दुखाइले बेहोस हुनु) सबैभन्दा सामान्य दन्त आकस्मिक अवस्था हो; सुताएर र अक्सिजन दिएर व्यवस्थापन गरिन्छ।

question: A supernumerary tooth is:
options: An extra tooth beyond the normal number
explanation: Supernumerary teeth are extra teeth; the commonest is a mesiodens between the upper central incisors.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सुपरन्युमेररी दाँत भनेको के हो?
options_ne: सामान्य संख्याभन्दा बढी भएको अतिरिक्त दाँत
explanation_ne: सुपरन्युमेररी दाँत अतिरिक्त दाँत हुन्; सबैभन्दा सामान्य माथिल्ला बीचका दाँतबीचको मेसियोडेन्स हो।

question: An impacted tooth is one that:
options: Fails to erupt into its normal position
explanation: Impaction means a tooth cannot erupt fully, often because of crowding — wisdom teeth are the commonest impacted teeth.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इम्प्याक्टेड दाँत भनेको कस्तो दाँत हो?
explanation_ne: इम्प्याक्सन भनेको दाँत पूर्ण रूपमा निस्कन नसक्नु हो, प्रायः भीडका कारण — बुद्धि दाँत सबैभन्दा बढी इम्प्याक्ट हुन्छन्।

question: Overjet in orthodontics refers to:
options: Horizontal overlap of upper front teeth over lower
explanation: Overjet is the horizontal distance between upper and lower incisors (normal 2–3 mm); overbite is the vertical overlap.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अर्थोडोन्टिक्समा ओभरजेट भनेको के हो?
options_ne: माथिल्ला अगाडिका दाँत तल्लाभन्दा तेर्सो रूपमा अगाडि हुनु
explanation_ne: ओभरजेट माथिल्ला र तल्ला इन्साइजरबीचको तेर्सो दूरी हो (सामान्य २–३ मिमि); ओभरबाइट ठाडो छोपाइ हो।

question: Normal overbite (vertical overlap of front teeth) is about:
explanation: A normal overbite is about 2–3 mm (roughly one-third of the lower incisor crown covered).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सामान्य ओभरबाइट (अगाडिका दाँतको ठाडो छोपाइ) लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: सामान्य ओभरबाइट लगभग २–३ मिमि हुन्छ (तल्लो इन्साइजरको मुकुटको करिब एक तिहाइ ढाकिएको)।

question: Which vitamin deficiency causes bleeding gums and scurvy, affecting oral health?
explanation: Vitamin C deficiency causes scurvy — bleeding, swollen gums and poor wound healing.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कुन भिटामिनको कमीले गिजाबाट रगत बग्ने र स्कर्वी हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: भिटामिन सीको कमीले स्कर्वी हुन्छ — गिजाबाट रगत बग्ने, सुन्निने र घाउ निको नहुने।

question: Pregnancy gingivitis is mainly caused by:
options: Hormonal changes increasing gum sensitivity to plaque
explanation: Raised oestrogen and progesterone in pregnancy make gums over-react to plaque, causing redness and bleeding.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गर्भावस्थाको जिन्जिभाइटिस मुख्यतः कुनले हुन्छ?
options_ne: हर्मोन परिवर्तनले गिजालाई प्लाकप्रति संवेदनशील बनाउनु
explanation_ne: गर्भावस्थामा एस्ट्रोजन र प्रोजेस्टेरोन बढ्दा गिजाले प्लाकप्रति बढी प्रतिक्रिया गर्छ, रातो हुने र रगत बग्ने हुन्छ।

question: Diabetes mellitus worsens periodontal disease because it:
options: Impairs healing and immune response in the gums
explanation: Diabetes and periodontitis worsen each other — poor glycaemic control impairs gum healing and immunity.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मधुमेहले पिरियोडोन्टल रोग किन बिगार्छ?
options_ne: यसले गिजाको निको हुने क्षमता र प्रतिरोध घटाउँछ
explanation_ne: मधुमेह र पिरियोडोन्टाइटिसले एकअर्कालाई बिगार्छन् — चिनी नियन्त्रण नहुँदा गिजा निको हुन र प्रतिरोध घट्छ।

question: Betel nut (supari) chewing is a major risk factor for:
options: Oral submucous fibrosis and oral cancer
explanation: Areca nut causes oral submucous fibrosis (stiff, burning mouth) and is a Group 1 carcinogen for oral cancer.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सुपारी चपाउनु कुनको प्रमुख जोखिम कारक हो?
options_ne: मुखको सबम्युकस फाइब्रोसिस र मुखको क्यान्सर
explanation_ne: सुपारीले मुखको सबम्युकस फाइब्रोसिस (मुख कडा र पोल्ने) गराउँछ र मुखको क्यान्सरको समूह १ कार्सिनोजेन हो।

question: Aphthous ulcers (mouth ulcers) are:
options: Painful, round, shallow ulcers that recur and heal without scarring
explanation: Recurrent aphthous stomatitis causes painful round ulcers with a white centre and red border, healing in 7–14 days.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एफ्थस अल्सर (मुखको घाउ) कस्तो हुन्छ?
options_ne: दुख्ने, गोलो, उथलो घाउ जुन दोहोरिन्छ र दागबिना निको हुन्छ
explanation_ne: बारम्बार हुने एफ्थस अल्सर सेतो केन्द्र र रातो किनार भएको दुख्ने गोलो घाउ हो, ७–१४ दिनमा निको हुन्छ।

question: The FDI two-digit tooth numbering system: tooth 11 refers to the:
explanation: In FDI notation the first digit is the quadrant (1 = upper right) and the second is the tooth (1 = central incisor).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एफडिआई दुई-अंक दाँत नम्बर प्रणालीमा दाँत ११ भनेको कुन हो?
explanation_ne: एफडिआईमा पहिलो अंक चापको भाग हो (१ = माथिल्लो दायाँ) र दोस्रो अंक दाँत हो (१ = बीचको दाँत)।

question: In the FDI system, tooth 36 refers to the:
explanation: FDI 36: quadrant 3 = lower left, tooth 6 = first molar.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एफडिआई प्रणालीमा दाँत ३६ भनेको कुन हो?
explanation_ne: एफडिआई ३६: भाग ३ = तल्लो बायाँ, दाँत ६ = पहिलो मोलर।

question: Dental floss is used to clean:
explanation: Floss reaches the contact areas between teeth where a brush cannot reach.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दन्त फ्लस कुन सफा गर्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: फ्लसले दाँतबीचको सम्पर्क क्षेत्र सफा गर्छ जहाँ ब्रस पुग्न सक्दैन।

question: Which is the correct order of cleaning for best plaque control?
explanation: Flossing before brushing loosens interdental plaque so brushing and fluoride can reach those surfaces.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्लाक नियन्त्रणका लागि सफाइको सही क्रम कुन हो?
explanation_ne: ब्रस गर्नुअघि फ्लस गर्दा दाँतबीचको प्लाक खुकुलो हुन्छ र ब्रस तथा फ्लोराइड ती सतहमा पुग्छ।

question: A dental hygienist's main role is:
options: Preventive oral care — scaling, polishing, oral-health education
explanation: Dental hygienists focus on prevention: scaling, polishing, fluoride application, sealants and patient education.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दन्त हाइजिनिस्टको मुख्य भूमिका के हो?
options_ne: रोकथाममूलक मुख हेरचाह — स्केलिङ, पालिस, मुख स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा
explanation_ne: दन्त हाइजिनिस्ट रोकथाममा केन्द्रित हुन्छन्: स्केलिङ, पालिस, फ्लोराइड, सिलेन्ट र बिरामी शिक्षा।

question: Which of the following is a sign of dental caries in its early stage?
explanation: Early caries appears as a chalky white spot (demineralisation) that can still be reversed with fluoride.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्यारिजको प्रारम्भिक चरणको लक्षण कुन हो?
explanation_ne: प्रारम्भिक क्यारिज इनामेलमा चकजस्तो सेतो दागका रूपमा देखिन्छ, जुन फ्लोराइडले फिर्ता हुन सक्छ।

question: Root canal treatment is done to:
options: Remove infected pulp and seal the root canal
explanation: Endodontic treatment removes infected pulp tissue, cleans and fills the canal to save the tooth.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रुट क्यानल उपचार किन गरिन्छ?
options_ne: संक्रमित पल्प हटाएर रुट क्यानल बन्द गर्न
explanation_ne: रुट क्यानल उपचारले संक्रमित पल्प हटाएर नली सफा गरी भर्छ, दाँत बचाउँछ।

question: Denture wearers should remove dentures at night because:
options: It lets the gums rest and prevents fungal infection
explanation: Night removal rests the mucosa, prevents denture stomatitis (Candida) and lets the denture be cleaned and soaked.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: डेन्चर लगाउनेले राति डेन्चर किन निकाल्नुपर्छ?
options_ne: गिजालाई आराम दिन र ढुसी संक्रमण रोक्न
explanation_ne: राति निकाल्दा मुखको छालालाई आराम मिल्छ, डेन्चर स्टोमाटाइटिस (क्यान्डिडा) रोकिन्छ र डेन्चर सफा गरी भिजाउन सकिन्छ।

question: The parotid gland opens into the mouth at:
explanation: The parotid (Stensen's) duct opens opposite the upper second molar; the submandibular duct opens under the tongue.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्यारोटिड ग्रन्थि मुखमा कुन ठाउँमा खुल्छ?
explanation_ne: प्यारोटिड (स्टेन्सेन) नली माथिल्लो दोस्रो मोलरको सामुन्ने खुल्छ; सबम्यान्डिबुलर नली जिब्रोमुनि खुल्छ।

question: The submandibular salivary gland duct opens:
explanation: Wharton's duct from the submandibular gland opens at the sublingual caruncle under the tongue.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सबम्यान्डिबुलर लार ग्रन्थिको नली कुन ठाउँमा खुल्छ?
explanation_ne: सबम्यान्डिबुलर ग्रन्थिको व्हार्टन नली जिब्रोमुनिको सबलिंगुअल क्यारन्कलमा खुल्छ।

question: Saliva's main protective function for teeth is:
explanation: Saliva buffers acid, supplies calcium and phosphate for remineralisation, and washes away food and bacteria.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दाँतका लागि लारको मुख्य सुरक्षात्मक काम के हो?
options_ne: अम्ललाई तटस्थ गरी इनामेल पुनः खनिजीकरण गर्ने
explanation_ne: लारले अम्ल तटस्थ गर्छ, पुनः खनिजीकरणका लागि क्याल्सियम र फस्फेट दिन्छ र खाना तथा जीवाणु पखाल्छ।

question: Halitosis (bad breath) is most commonly caused by:
options: Oral bacteria, tongue coating and gum disease
explanation: Most halitosis comes from the mouth — bacterial breakdown of food debris on the tongue and in gum pockets.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: ह्यालिटोसिस (मुख गन्हाउने) प्रायः कुनले हुन्छ?
options_ne: मुखका जीवाणु, जिब्रोको तह र गिजाको रोग
explanation_ne: धेरैजसो ह्यालिटोसिस मुखबाटै हुन्छ — जिब्रो र गिजाका खाडलमा खानाका अवशेष जीवाणुले कुहिँदा।

question: Tongue cleaning is recommended because the tongue:
options: Is not part of oral hygiene
Harbour bacteria that cause bad breath and plaque
explanation: The tongue's rough surface traps bacteria and debris; cleaning it reduces halitosis and bacterial load.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: जिब्रो सफा गर्न सिफारिस गरिन्छ किनकि जिब्रोले:
options_ne: मुख गन्हाउने र प्लाक गराउने जीवाणु राख्छ
explanation_ne: जिब्रोको खस्रो सतहले जीवाणु र फोहोर समात्छ; सफा गर्दा गन्हाउने र जीवाणु भार घट्छ।

question: Which age group is most at risk of early childhood caries?
explanation: Early childhood caries affects children under 6, often from sugary drinks in bottles at bedtime.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बाल्यकालको प्रारम्भिक क्यारिजको सबैभन्दा बढी जोखिम कुन उमेर समूहमा हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: बाल्यकालको प्रारम्भिक क्यारिज ६ वर्षमुनिका बच्चामा हुन्छ, प्रायः सुत्ने बेला बोतलमा गुलियो पेय पदार्थ दिँदा।

question: A dental hygienist must obtain what before starting treatment?
options: Informed consent and a medical history
explanation: A medical history (allergies, medicines, systemic disease) and informed consent are essential before any dental treatment.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: दन्त हाइजिनिस्टले उपचार सुरु गर्नुअघि के लिनुपर्छ?
explanation_ne: उपचारअघि चिकित्सा इतिहास (एलर्जी, औषधि, प्रणालीगत रोग) र सूचित सहमति आवश्यक छ।

question: Which of the following is a contraindication for ultrasonic scaling?
options: A patient with an implanted cardiac pacemaker (older types)
explanation: Older ultrasonic scalers could interfere with some pacemakers; modern magnetostrictive units are generally considered safe, but the history must be checked.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अल्ट्रासोनिक स्केलिङको प्रतिकूल अवस्था कुन हो?
options_ne: इम्प्लान्टेड कार्डियक पेसमेकर भएका बिरामी (पुराना प्रकार)
explanation_ne: पुराना अल्ट्रासोनिक स्केलरले केही पेसमेकरमा हस्तक्षेप गर्न सक्छन्; आधुनिक यन्त्र प्रायः सुरक्षित मानिन्छन्, तर इतिहास जाँच्नुपर्छ।

question: Enamel begins to demineralise below which critical pH?
explanation: Below pH 5.5, enamel hydroxyapatite dissolves; fluoride lowers this critical pH.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इनामेल कुन क्रिटिकल पिएचभन्दा तल खिइन थाल्छ?
explanation_ne: पिएच ५.५ भन्दा तल इनामेलको हाइड्रोक्सीएपेटाइट पग्लन्छ; फ्लोराइडले यो क्रिटिकल पिएच घटाउँछ।

question: Which tooth has the longest root in the mouth?
explanation: The maxillary canine has the longest root of any tooth, which is why it is often the last to be lost.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मुखमा सबैभन्दा लामो जरा कुन दाँतको हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: माथिल्लो कुकुर दाँतको जरा सबैभन्दा लामो हुन्छ, त्यसैले यो प्रायः अन्तिममा झर्छ।

question: How many roots does a typical upper first molar have?
explanation: Upper molars usually have three roots (two buccal, one palatal); lower molars usually have two.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सामान्य माथिल्लो पहिलो मोलरका कति जरा हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: माथिल्ला मोलरमा प्रायः तीन जरा हुन्छन् (दुई गालातिर, एक तालुतिर); तल्ला मोलरमा प्रायः दुई हुन्छन्।

question: How many roots does a typical lower first molar have?
explanation: Lower molars usually have two roots (mesial and distal); upper molars usually have three.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सामान्य तल्लो पहिलो मोलरका कति जरा हुन्छन्?
explanation_ne: तल्ला मोलरमा प्रायः दुई जरा हुन्छन् (मेसियल र डिस्टल); माथिल्ला मोलरमा प्रायः तीन हुन्छन्।

question: X-rays were discovered in 1895 by:
explanation: Roentgen discovered X-rays in 1895 while working with cathode-ray tubes; he received the first Nobel Prize in Physics in 1901.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एक्स-रे सन् १८९५ मा कसले पत्ता लगाए?
explanation_ne: रोन्टजेनले १८९५ मा क्याथोड-रे ट्युबसँग काम गर्दा एक्स-रे पत्ता लगाए; उनले १९०१ मा भौतिकशास्त्रको पहिलो नोबेल पुरस्कार पाए।

question: X-rays are a form of:
explanation: X-rays are high-energy electromagnetic waves with short wavelengths, between ultraviolet and gamma rays.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एक्स-रे कुन प्रकारको विकिरण हो?
explanation_ne: एक्स-रे छोटो तरंगदैर्ध्य भएका उच्च-ऊर्जा विद्युतचुम्बकीय तरंग हुन्, पराबैंगनी र गामा किरणबीच पर्छन्।

question: ALARA in radiography means:
explanation: ALARA is the guiding principle of radiation protection: keep doses as low as reasonably achievable.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोग्राफीमा ALARA भनेको के हो?
options_ne: जति सकिन्छ त्यति कम (As Low As Reasonably Achievable)
explanation_ne: ALARA विकिरण सुरक्षाको मार्गदर्शक सिद्धान्त हो: मात्रा उचित रूपमा सकेसम्म कम राख्नु।

question: The three basic principles of radiation protection are:
explanation: Reduce time near the source, maximise distance, and use shielding (lead aprons, barriers).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विकिरण सुरक्षाका तीन आधारभूत सिद्धान्त के हुन्?
explanation_ne: स्रोत नजिकको समय घटाउने, दूरी बढाउने र ढाल (सिसाको एप्रन, बाधा) प्रयोग गर्ने।

question: The recommended occupational dose limit for radiation workers (averaged over 5 years) is:
explanation: ICRP recommends 20 mSv/year averaged over 5 years (max 50 mSv in any single year) for occupational exposure; the public limit is 1 mSv/year.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विकिरणकर्मीका लागि सिफारिस गरिएको व्यावसायिक मात्रा सीमा (५ वर्षको औसत) कति हो?
explanation_ne: आइसिआरपीले व्यावसायिक जोखिमका लागि ५ वर्षको औसतमा प्रतिवर्ष २० मिलिसिभर्ट (कुनै एक वर्षमा बढीमा ५०) सिफारिस गर्छ; सर्वसाधारणको सीमा प्रतिवर्ष १ मिलिसिभर्ट हो।

question: The dose limit for members of the general public is:
explanation: The public dose limit is 1 mSv per year above natural background radiation.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सर्वसाधारणका लागि मात्रा सीमा कति हो?
explanation_ne: सर्वसाधारणको मात्रा सीमा प्राकृतिक पृष्ठभूमि विकिरणभन्दा माथि प्रतिवर्ष १ मिलिसिभर्ट हो।

question: A lead apron used in radiography usually has a lead equivalence of:
explanation: Standard protective aprons are 0.5 mm lead equivalent, which attenuates most scattered diagnostic X-rays.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोग्राफीमा प्रयोग हुने सिसाको एप्रनको सिसा बराबर मोटाइ कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: मानक सुरक्षात्मक एप्रन ०.५ मिमि सिसा बराबर हुन्छ, जसले धेरैजसो छरिएको निदानात्मक एक्स-रेलाई रोक्छ।

question: The target material in a diagnostic X-ray tube is usually:
explanation: Tungsten (high atomic number 74, very high melting point 3422°C) is the standard anode target material.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: निदानात्मक एक्स-रे ट्युबमा लक्ष्य सामग्री प्रायः कुन हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: टंगस्टन (उच्च परमाणु संख्या ७४, धेरै उच्च पग्लने बिन्दु ३४२२°से) मानक एनोड लक्ष्य सामग्री हो।

question: kVp in radiography controls mainly the:
options: Penetrating power (quality) of the X-ray beam
explanation: kVp (kilovoltage peak) sets the maximum energy of the beam — its penetration; mA controls the quantity of X-rays.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोग्राफीमा केभिपिले मुख्यतः के नियन्त्रण गर्छ?
explanation_ne: केभिपिले किरणको अधिकतम ऊर्जा — छेड्ने शक्ति — निर्धारण गर्छ; एमएले एक्स-रेको मात्रा नियन्त्रण गर्छ।

question: mA in radiography controls mainly the:
explanation: mA (tube current) controls how many electrons hit the target, hence how many X-rays are produced; mAs = mA × time.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोग्राफीमा एमएले मुख्यतः के नियन्त्रण गर्छ?
explanation_ne: एमए (ट्युब करेन्ट) ले लक्ष्यमा कति इलेक्ट्रोन ठोक्किन्छन् भन्ने नियन्त्रण गर्छ, त्यसैले कति एक्स-रे बन्छन् भन्ने निर्धारण गर्छ।

question: The inverse square law states that radiation intensity is:
options: Proportional to the cube of distance
Inversely proportional to the square of the distance
explanation: Doubling the distance from the source reduces intensity to one-quarter — the basis of distance as protection.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: इन्भर्स स्क्वायर नियमअनुसार विकिरण तीव्रता कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: स्रोतबाट दूरी दोब्बर पार्दा तीव्रता एक चौथाइ हुन्छ — दूरीलाई सुरक्षाका रूपमा प्रयोग गर्ने आधार।

question: In a chest X-ray, the standard projection is:
explanation: PA erect chest X-ray minimises heart magnification and shows both lung fields at full inspiration.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: छातीको एक्स-रेमा मानक प्रोजेक्सन कुन हो?
explanation_ne: पिए उभिएको छाती एक्स-रेले मुटुको ठूलोपन कम गर्छ र दुवै फोक्सो पूर्ण श्वासमा देखाउँछ।

question: On the Hounsfield scale, water has a value of:
explanation: By definition water is 0 HU, air is −1000 HU and dense bone is about +1000 HU.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हाउन्सफिल्ड स्केलमा पानीको मान कति हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: परिभाषाअनुसार पानी ० HU, हावा −१००० HU र बाक्लो हड्डी लगभग +१००० HU हुन्छ।

question: MRI uses which of the following to form images?
options: Magnetic fields and radio waves (no ionising radiation)
explanation: MRI aligns hydrogen protons with a strong magnetic field and radiofrequency pulses; it uses no ionising radiation.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एमआरआईले तस्बिर बनाउन के प्रयोग गर्छ?
options_ne: चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र र रेडियो तरंग (आयनीकरण विकिरण छैन)
explanation_ne: एमआरआईले बलियो चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र र रेडियोफ्रिक्वेन्सी पल्सले हाइड्रोजन प्रोटोनलाई मिलाउँछ; यसमा आयनीकरण विकिरण हुँदैन।

question: A major contraindication for MRI is:
explanation: Ferromagnetic objects and non-MRI-conditional pacemakers are dangerous in the strong magnetic field; screening is mandatory.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एमआरआईको प्रमुख प्रतिकूल अवस्था कुन हो?
explanation_ne: बलियो चुम्बकीय क्षेत्रमा फेरोम्याग्नेटिक वस्तु र एमआरआई-अनुकूल नभएका पेसमेकर खतरनाक हुन्छन्; जाँच अनिवार्य छ।

question: Ultrasound imaging is based on:
explanation: Ultrasound uses piezoelectric crystals to send sound waves (above 20 kHz) and records their echoes; it uses no ionising radiation.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अल्ट्रासाउन्ड तस्बिर के मा आधारित छ?
explanation_ne: अल्ट्रासाउन्डले पिजोइलेक्ट्रिक क्रिस्टलले ध्वनि तरंग (२० किलोहर्जभन्दा माथि) पठाएर प्रतिध्वनि रेकर्ड गर्छ; यसमा आयनीकरण विकिरण हुँदैन।

question: The contrast medium most commonly used for a barium swallow is:
explanation: Barium sulphate is a radio-opaque suspension used to outline the oesophagus, stomach and bowel.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बेरियम स्वालोमा सबैभन्दा बढी प्रयोग हुने कन्ट्रास्ट माध्यम कुन हो?
explanation_ne: बेरियम सल्फेट रेडियो-अपारदर्शी निलम्बन हो जसले अन्ननली, पेट र आन्द्राको रूपरेखा देखाउँछ।

question: Gadolinium is used as a contrast agent in:
explanation: Gadolinium-based agents shorten T1 relaxation and enhance MRI images; iodine agents are used in CT/X-ray.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गाडोलिनियम कुनमा कन्ट्रास्ट एजेन्टका रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: गाडोलिनियममा आधारित एजेन्टले T1 रिल्याक्सेसन छोट्याएर एमआरआई तस्बिर बढाउँछ; आयोडिन एजेन्ट सिटी/एक्स-रेमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।

question: Which radiographic view best shows the cervical spine after trauma?
options: Lateral view (with AP and open-mouth odontoid views)
explanation: The standard cervical spine series is AP + lateral + open-mouth (odontoid peg) views; the lateral view is most critical after trauma.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: आघातपछि ग्रीवाको मेरुदण्ड देखाउन उत्तम दृश्य कुन हो?
options_ne: लेटरल दृश्य (एपी र मुख खोलेर ओडोन्टोइड दृश्यसहित)
explanation_ne: मानक ग्रीवा मेरुदण्ड श्रृंखला एपी + लेटरल + मुख खोलेर (ओडोन्टोइड) दृश्य हो; आघातपछि लेटरल दृश्य सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण छ।

question: A '10-day rule' in radiography relates to:
options: Avoiding X-ray exposure of women of childbearing age in the first 10 days after menstruation
explanation: The 10-day rule limited elective abdominal/pelvic X-rays to the first 10 days of the menstrual cycle to avoid irradiating an early pregnancy.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोग्राफीमा '१०-दिन नियम' के सँग सम्बन्धित छ?
options_ne: मासिक धर्मपछिका पहिलो १० दिनमा प्रसव उमेरका महिलामा एक्स-रे नगर्ने
explanation_ne: १०-दिन नियमले प्रारम्भिक गर्भावस्थामा विकिरण नपरोस् भनेर मासिक चक्रका पहिलो १० दिनमा मात्र पेट/श्रोणिको एक्स-रे सीमित गर्थ्यो।

question: PACS in a radiology department stands for:
explanation: PACS stores, retrieves and distributes digital medical images, usually in DICOM format.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोलोजी विभागमा PACS भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: PACS ले डिजिटल चिकित्सा तस्बिरहरू भण्डारण, पुनःप्राप्ति र वितरण गर्छ, प्रायः DICOM ढाँचामा।

question: DICOM is the standard for:
explanation: DICOM (Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine) is the universal standard for medical image files and exchange.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: DICOM कुनको मानक हो?
explanation_ne: DICOM (डिजिटल इमेजिङ एन्ड कम्युनिकेसन्स इन मेडिसिन) चिकित्सा तस्बिर फाइल र आदानप्रदानको विश्वव्यापी मानक हो।

question: Fluoroscopy differs from plain radiography because it:
explanation: Fluoroscopy gives live, moving X-ray images (e.g. during barium studies or catheter procedures) using an image intensifier.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फ्लुरोस्कोपी साधारण रेडियोग्राफीभन्दा फरक छ किनकि यसले:
explanation_ne: फ्लुरोस्कोपीले इमेज इन्टेन्सिफायर प्रयोग गरी प्रत्यक्ष चलायमान एक्स-रे तस्बिर दिन्छ (बेरियम अध्ययन वा क्याथेटर प्रक्रियामा)।

question: Mammography uses which type of X-ray tube target/filter combination for soft-tissue contrast?
explanation: Mammography uses a molybdenum (or rhodium) target and filter to produce low-energy X-rays ideal for breast soft tissue.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: म्यामोग्राफीले नरम तन्तुको कन्ट्रास्टका लागि कुन ट्युब लक्ष्य/फिल्टर प्रयोग गर्छ?
explanation_ne: म्यामोग्राफीले स्तनको नरम तन्तुका लागि उपयुक्त कम-ऊर्जा एक्स-रे बनाउन मोलिब्डेनम (वा रोडियम) लक्ष्य र फिल्टर प्रयोग गर्छ।

question: Radiographic density refers to:
options: The degree of blackening on the radiograph
explanation: Density is overall blackening; contrast is the difference in density between adjacent areas.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोग्राफिक घनत्व भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: घनत्व भनेको समग्र कालोपन हो; कन्ट्रास्ट छेउछेउका क्षेत्रबीचको घनत्वको भिन्नता हो।

question: Increasing kVp while keeping mAs constant will:
options: Increase density and decrease contrast (longer grey scale)
explanation: Higher kVp produces more penetrating, higher-energy photons — the image gets darker with more grey shades (lower contrast).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एमएएस स्थिर राखी केभिपि बढाउँदा के हुन्छ?
options_ne: घनत्व बढ्छ र कन्ट्रास्ट घट्छ (लामो खैरो स्केल)
explanation_ne: उच्च केभिपिले बढी छेड्ने, उच्च-ऊर्जा फोटोन बनाउँछ — तस्बिर गाढा हुन्छ र खैरो छायाँ बढ्छ (कन्ट्रास्ट कम)।

question: Magnification in radiography increases when the:
options: Object is closer to the film
explanation: Magnification = SID / SOD; moving the object away from the film (or the source closer) increases magnification and blur.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोग्राफीमा आवर्धन कहिले बढ्छ?
explanation_ne: आवर्धन = SID / SOD; वस्तुलाई फिल्मबाट टाढा लैजाँदा (वा स्रोत नजिक ल्याउँदा) आवर्धन र धमिलोपन बढ्छ।

question: The safelight used in a darkroom is usually:
explanation: Red/amber safelight does not expose conventional X-ray film, so films can be handled under it.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: डार्करूममा प्रयोग हुने सेफलाइट प्रायः कुन रंगको हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: रातो/पहेंलो-रातो सेफलाइटले परम्परागत एक्स-रे फिल्मलाई एक्सपोज गर्दैन, त्यसैले फिल्म त्यसको प्रकाशमा चलाउन सकिन्छ।

question: An intensifying screen in a cassette is used to:
options: Convert X-rays to visible light and reduce patient dose
explanation: Intensifying screens convert X-ray energy to light, exposing the film more efficiently and allowing much lower doses.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: क्यासेटमा इन्टेन्सिफाइङ स्क्रिन कुनका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options_ne: एक्स-रेलाई दृश्य प्रकाशमा बदल्न र बिरामीको मात्रा घटाउन
explanation_ne: इन्टेन्सिफाइङ स्क्रिनले एक्स-रे ऊर्जालाई प्रकाशमा बदल्छ, फिल्मलाई प्रभावकारी रूपमा एक्सपोज गर्छ र मात्रा धेरै कम गर्छ।

question: Which body part is most sensitive to radiation?
options: Gonads and bone marrow (rapidly dividing cells)
explanation: Rapidly dividing, undifferentiated cells (gonads, bone marrow, foetus, lens of eye) are most radiosensitive.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: शरीरको कुन भाग विकिरणप्रति सबैभन्दा संवेदनशील छ?
options_ne: जनन ग्रन्थि र हड्डीको मज्जा (छिटो विभाजन हुने कोष)
explanation_ne: छिटो विभाजन हुने, अविभेदित कोषहरू (जनन ग्रन्थि, हड्डीको मज्जा, भ्रूण, आँखाको लेन्स) विकिरणप्रति सबैभन्दा संवेदनशील हुन्छन्।

question: The unit of absorbed radiation dose is:
explanation: Absorbed dose is measured in Gray (1 Gy = 1 J/kg); equivalent/effective dose is in Sievert; activity is in Becquerel.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: अवशोषित विकिरण मात्राको एकाइ कुन हो?
explanation_ne: अवशोषित मात्रा ग्रेमा नापिन्छ (१ Gy = १ J/kg); बराबर/प्रभावकारी मात्रा सिभर्टमा र सक्रियता बेकरेलमा नापिन्छ।

question: The unit of effective radiation dose is:
explanation: Effective dose, which weights tissue sensitivity, is measured in Sievert (Sv).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्रभावकारी विकिरण मात्राको एकाइ कुन हो?
explanation_ne: प्रभावकारी मात्रा, जसले तन्तु संवेदनशीलतालाई तौल दिन्छ, सिभर्ट (Sv) मा नापिन्छ।

question: Radioactivity is measured in:
explanation: Activity (disintegrations per second) is measured in Becquerel; 1 Bq = 1 disintegration per second.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोधर्मिता कुन एकाइमा नापिन्छ?
explanation_ne: सक्रियता (प्रतिसेकेन्ड विघटन) बेकरेलमा नापिन्छ; १ Bq = प्रतिसेकेन्ड १ विघटन।

question: Which investigation is best for diagnosing a pulmonary embolism?
explanation: CTPA is the gold-standard test for pulmonary embolism, showing filling defects in pulmonary arteries.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: फुफ्फुसीय एम्बोलिजम निदान गर्न उत्तम जाँच कुन हो?
explanation_ne: CTPA फुफ्फुसीय एम्बोलिजमको स्वर्ण-मानक परीक्षण हो, जसले फुफ्फुसीय धमनीमा भर्ने दोष देखाउँछ।

question: A lytic bone lesion on X-ray appears as:
options: A dark (radiolucent) area where bone is destroyed
explanation: Lytic lesions destroy bone and appear dark (lucent); sclerotic lesions appear white (dense).
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: एक्स-रेमा लाइटिक हड्डी घाउ कस्तो देखिन्छ?
explanation_ne: लाइटिक घाउले हड्डी नष्ट गर्छ र कालो (लुसेन्ट) देखिन्छ; स्क्लेरोटिक घाउ सेतो (बाक्लो) देखिन्छ।

question: In a normal chest X-ray, the heart shadow should occupy less than:
explanation: The cardiothoracic ratio should be under 0.5 on a PA film; above that suggests cardiomegaly.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: सामान्य छाती एक्स-रेमा मुटुको छायाँ छातीको चौडाइको कति भन्दा कम हुनुपर्छ?
explanation_ne: पिए फिल्ममा कार्डियोथोरासिक अनुपात ०.५ भन्दा कम हुनुपर्छ; त्योभन्दा माथि भए मुटु ठूलो भएको संकेत गर्छ।

question: Which view is used to demonstrate the paranasal sinuses?
explanation: The Waters (occipitomental) view projects the maxillary sinuses clear of the petrous bones.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: प्यारानासल साइनस देखाउन कुन दृश्य प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: वाटर्स (ओसिपिटोमेन्टल) दृश्यले म्याक्सिलरी साइनसलाई पेट्रस हड्डीबाट अलग देखाउँछ।

question: A Colles' fracture involves the:
explanation: Colles' fracture is a distal radius fracture with dorsal displacement, common after a fall on an outstretched hand in older adults.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कोल्स फ्र्याक्चर कुनमा हुन्छ?
explanation_ne: कोल्स फ्र्याक्चर दूरस्थ रेडियसको भाँचाइ हो जसमा पृष्ठीय विस्थापन हुन्छ, वृद्धहरूमा हात टेकेर लड्दा सामान्य।

question: The '10-day rule' and gonad shielding are part of protecting which group most?
options: Women of childbearing age and children
explanation: The foetus and children's rapidly dividing cells are most radiosensitive, so protection focuses on pregnant women and children.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: १०-दिन नियम र जनन ग्रन्थि ढाल कुन समूहको सुरक्षाका लागि बढी हो?
explanation_ne: भ्रूण र बच्चाका छिटो विभाजन हुने कोषहरू विकिरणप्रति सबैभन्दा संवेदनशील हुन्छन्, त्यसैले सुरक्षा गर्भवती महिला र बच्चामा केन्द्रित हुन्छ।

question: Which contrast study outlines the urinary system (kidneys, ureters, bladder)?
explanation: IVU injects iodinated contrast intravenously; serial films show the kidneys, ureters and bladder.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: मूत्र प्रणाली (मिर्गौला, मूत्रनली, मूत्राशय) देखाउने कन्ट्रास्ट अध्ययन कुन हो?
explanation_ne: आइभियुमा आयोडिनयुक्त कन्ट्रास्ट शिराबाट दिइन्छ; क्रमिक फिल्मले मिर्गौला, मूत्रनली र मूत्राशय देखाउँछ।

question: Barium enema is used to examine the:
explanation: A barium enema outlines the colon; a barium meal/follow-through examines the stomach and small bowel.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: बेरियम एनिमा कुन जाँच्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation_ne: बेरियम एनिमाले कोलनको रूपरेखा देखाउँछ; बेरियम भोजन/फलो-थ्रुले पेट र सानो आन्द्रा जाँच गर्छ।

question: Hysterosalpingography (HSG) is used to assess:
explanation: HSG injects contrast through the cervix to outline the uterine cavity and check whether the tubes are open.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: हिस्टेरोसाल्पिङ्गोग्राफी (HSG) कुन जाँच्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
options_ne: पाठेघर र फ्यालोपियन नली खुला छ कि छैन
explanation_ne: HSG मा पाठेघरको मुखबाट कन्ट्रास्ट हालेर पाठेघरको खाली ठाउँ देखाइन्छ र नली खुला छ कि छैन जाँचिन्छ।

question: In radiography, 'penumbra' refers to:
options: The darkest part of the film
Geometric blurring at the edge of the image
explanation: Penumbra is the blurred edge caused by the finite size of the focal spot; a smaller focal spot gives less penumbra and sharper images.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोग्राफीमा 'पेनम्ब्रा' भनेको के हो?
explanation_ne: पेनम्ब्रा फोकल स्पटको सीमित आकारले हुने किनारको धमिलोपन हो; सानो फोकल स्पटले कम पेनम्ब्रा र स्पष्ट तस्बिर दिन्छ।

question: Which of the following is a stochastic effect of radiation?
explanation: Stochastic effects (cancer, genetic effects) have no threshold and probability rises with dose; deterministic effects (burns, cataract) have thresholds.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन विकिरणको स्टोकास्टिक प्रभाव हो?
explanation_ne: स्टोकास्टिक प्रभाव (क्यान्सर, आनुवंशिक प्रभाव) को कुनै सीमा हुँदैन र मात्रा बढ्दा सम्भावना बढ्छ; निर्धारणात्मक प्रभाव (पोल्नु, मोतियाबिन्दु) को सीमा हुन्छ।

question: A deterministic effect of radiation is one that:
options: Has a threshold dose and worsens with dose above it
explanation: Deterministic effects (skin erythema, cataract, sterility) appear only above a threshold dose and increase in severity with dose.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: विकिरणको निर्धारणात्मक प्रभाव भनेको के हो?
options_ne: सीमा मात्रा हुने र त्योभन्दा माथि मात्रा बढ्दा बिग्रने
explanation_ne: निर्धारणात्मक प्रभाव (छाला रातो हुनु, मोतियाबिन्दु, बाँझोपन) सीमा मात्राभन्दा माथि मात्र देखिन्छ र मात्रा बढ्दा गम्भीरता बढ्छ।

question: The most radiosensitive phase of the cell cycle is:
explanation: Cells are most radiosensitive in M phase and most resistant in late S phase, when DNA is being synthesised.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: कोष चक्रको सबैभन्दा विकिरण-संवेदनशील चरण कुन हो?
explanation_ne: कोषहरू एम चरणमा सबैभन्दा संवेदनशील र एस चरणको अन्त्यमा सबैभन्दा प्रतिरोधी हुन्छन्, जब डिएनए संश्लेषण भइरहेको हुन्छ।

question: A radiographer must wear a personal dosimeter (TLD badge) to:
explanation: A TLD badge records the wearer's accumulated dose over a period (usually monthly) for regulatory monitoring.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: रेडियोग्राफरले व्यक्तिगत डोसिमिटर (TLD ब्याज) किन लगाउनुपर्छ?
options_ne: सञ्चित व्यावसायिक विकिरण मात्रा निगरानी गर्न
explanation_ne: TLD ब्याजले लगाउने व्यक्तिको निश्चित अवधि (प्रायः मासिक) मा सञ्चित मात्रा रेकर्ड गर्छ, नियमन निगरानीका लागि।

question: Where should a TLD badge be worn?
options: On the back of the head
At chest level, under the lead apron
explanation: The badge is worn at chest level under the apron to estimate whole-body dose to the trunk.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: TLD ब्याज कुन ठाउँमा लगाउनुपर्छ?
explanation_ne: ब्याज छातीको स्तरमा एप्रनमुनि लगाइन्छ ताकि धड़को सम्पूर्ण शरीरको मात्रा अनुमान गर्न सकियोस्।

question: Which imaging modality is safest in pregnancy for the foetus?
explanation: Ultrasound uses sound waves, not ionising radiation, and is the first-line imaging in pregnancy.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: गर्भावस्थामा भ्रूणका लागि सबैभन्दा सुरक्षित इमेजिङ विधि कुन हो?
explanation_ne: अल्ट्रासाउन्डले ध्वनि तरंग प्रयोग गर्छ, आयनीकरण विकिरण होइन, र गर्भावस्थामा पहिलो रोजाइको इमेजिङ हो।

question: The 'air bronchogram' sign on a chest X-ray suggests:
explanation: Air bronchogram — air-filled bronchi visible against opaque consolidated lung — is a classic sign of pneumonia.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
question_ne: छातीको एक्स-रेमा 'एयर ब्रोन्कोग्राम' चिन्हले के संकेत गर्छ?
explanation_ne: एयर ब्रोन्कोग्राम — अपारदर्शी कन्सोलिडेटेड फोक्सोमा हवाले भरिएका ब्रोन्की देखिनु — निमोनियाको शास्त्रीय चिन्ह हो।

question: A pneumothorax on chest X-ray is recognised by:
options: Absence of lung markings at the periphery with a visible pleural edge
